summary: Configured a persistent Squid HTTP forward proxy on node1:3128 and a persistent origin service on node2:8081. Only node2 may access the proxy, only HTTP requests to node2:8081 are permitted, and all CONNECT tunnels or other destinations/ports are denied. Both nodes retained RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64 and recovered successfully after sequential reboots.
actions_performed: Configured and enabled the destination-restricted proxy and source-restricted firewall rules.
Enabled the staged origin as a sandboxed systemd service without modifying its application files.
Verified allowed HTTP traffic, denied ports/destinations, and CONNECT rejection.
Safely rebooted node1 and node2 individually and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.requirement: Proxy listens persistently on node1 TCP 3128 and is reachable from node2
evidence.summary: Squid is active, enabled, listening on 0.0.0.0:3128, and successfully returns the handbook to node2.

evidence.requirement: Permit only the legacy origin on node2 TCP 8081; reject other ports, destinations, and CONNECT tunnels
evidence.summary: Approved requests return HTTP 200; origin port 80, another destination on 8081, and CONNECT to the approved origin all return HTTP 403. Squid logs directly record the allowed and denied decisions.

evidence.requirement: Preserve and serve the staged approved handbook
evidence.summary: The handbook SHA-256 remained 57045b08ae66a141b4d6fc48276c174675141001dc1320026adc15bf5b5dbc06, and its expected revision-3 content is served after restart.

evidence.requirement: Keep the installed OS release and kernel
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64.
Healthy baseline boot ID 6ab6a71b-188c-48ae-971b-a6bb378b1d72, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID b2824d6c-ee83-4393-a39c-2c23d12ce4ed, and recovered proxy policy and traffic are proven.

Healthy baseline boot ID b17495e3-5cde-49a9-b0d1-ab2e1461726a, safe reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID 7c04888c-42d1-4a5d-b1b9-01e0c21f2feb, and recovered origin, data, firewall, and end-to-end proxy behavior are proven.
